content: Anthropic prompt caching (platform.claude.com): up to 4 breakpoints; order tools->system->messages; tool def change invalidates all, tool_choice change invalidates messages only; min cacheable: Haiku 4.5 = 4096, Sonnet 5/4.5/4.6 = 1024, Opus 5/5.5/Sonnet 5.5 = 512, Opus 4.5/4.6 = 4096; below min silently uncached (both cache fields 0); TTL 5m (1.25x write) or 1h (2x); reads 0.1x; input_tokens = only tokens after last breakpoint; 20-block lookback; new top-level automatic cache_control moves breakpoint forward; 400 if 4 explicit + automatic.
